markers.source_locator: Results: 'Fine-mapping risk variants for COVID-19 respiratory failure at the 3p21.31 locus...' section, para. 2; Fig. 5D legend
markers.source_context: SLC6A20, which encodes a proline transporter, was expressed predominantly in AT2 cells and had low expression in other cell types (Figure 5D). Figure 5D legend: 'Expression of SLC6A20 across lung cell types, where each dot represents a nucleus. The highest expression observed was in AT2 cells.'
ACE2 was detected in a small number of cells and mostly confined to AT2 cells.
Among the putative target genes for this cCRE was SLC6A20 which was predominantly expressed in AT2 cells.
TMPRSS2 was expressed in a higher fraction of nuclei predominantly from the epithelial lineage.
